name: Tavelo Arow SL custom build
why_interesting: A 710 g-class aero frameset with T1100-claimed carbon, BB86 and 32 mm clearance, plus a separately reported 6.2 kg custom build.
missing: Measured weight evidence and factory claimed weight
Current mainland frame or complete-bike price and purchase route
Exact component list and repeatability of the reported custom-build weight

facts.frame: T1100-claimed frame; T800-claimed fork and seatpost; official raw frame starts at 710 g
facts.sizes: Official starting frame-weight basis is XS
facts.drivetrain_status: No complete attributable custom-build drivetrain established after 50 registered source areas
facts.complete_weight_basis: Single exact public custom-build report; size, complete BOM and independent scale protocol are unpublished
facts.price_status: No attributable current mainland CNY custom-build price found after 50 registered source areas
facts.stiffness_evidence: Manufacturer claims enhanced headtube and downtube stiffness for the exact Arow platform; qualitative evidence without a numeric protocol

support_note: The official page provides a direct global route. Tavelo's policy states lifetime frameset coverage for the original purchaser through official or authorized channels; mainland handling and custom-build components require confirmation.
source_note: The official frameset page confirms the 710 g raw XS basis and qualitative headtube/downtube stiffness. The 6.2 kg complete figure remains one exact public custom-build report without a full BOM or independent scale protocol. A current mainland CNY amount remains unknown after 50 areas.
